Headline: Temporary Reroute at Austin/Bell Plaine
ShortDescription: #91 Austin buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near Austin/Bell Plaine.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#91 Austin buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Austin, Montrose, Narragansett, Irving Park, Austin, and over regular route, due to street blockage near Austin/Bell Plaine.

Allow extra travel time.
